actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Alax makes two Fire Strike attacks.

actions.name: Fire Strike
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 60 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (2d6 + 3) fire damage.

actions.name: Breath Weapon (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Alax exhales a 15-foot cone of fire. Each creature in that area must make a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Alax casts one of the following spells, using Wisdom as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 13):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Druidcraft|Druidcraft]], [[Tools/Spells/Resistance|Resistance]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Cure Wounds|Cure Wounds]], [[Tools/Spells/Faerie Fire|Faerie Fire]], [[Tools/Spells/Purify Food And Drink|Purify Food and Drink]]

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.desc: Ervan uses his staff to make three Arcane Blast attacks.

actions.name: Arcane Blast
actions.desc: Melee or Ranged Spell Attack: +6 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (3d6 + 3) force damage.

actions.name: Acid Rain (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
actions.desc: Acid falls in a 10-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder centered on a point Ervan can see within 120 feet of himself. Each creature in that area must make a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 22 (4d10) acid damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

actions.name: Spellcasting
actions.desc:
Ervan casts one of the following spells, using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC 14):

- **At Will:** [[Tools/Spells/Light|Light]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Hand|Mage Hand]]
- **2/Day:** [[Tools/Spells/Dimension Door|Dimension Door]]
- **1/Day Each:** [[Tools/Spells/Disguise Self|Disguise Self]], [[Tools/Spells/Levitate|Levitate]], [[Tools/Spells/Mage Armor|Mage Armor]]
